metadata.description: TokenScope plugin marketplace. At the repo root so `claude plugin marketplace add <owner>/<repo>` resolves it; add with `--sparse .claude-plugin plugin` to sparse-checkout only those directories. The plugins talk to the deployment whose host is baked into them: see plugin/README.md, Point the plugins at your deployment.

plugins.name: tokenscope
plugins.description: Attribute Claude Code token spend to projects via the TokenScope attestation API.

plugins.name: tokenscope-copilot
plugins.description: Attribute GitHub Copilot CLI token spend to projects via the TokenScope attribution platform.
